positions.description: As part of the small team running this education and research institute in Munich, I was responsible for IT, international relations, and course management. For the study program Technology Management I created and conducted various workshops and lectures related to product development and/or IT. Over the years I led and advised more than 25 project teams working with renowned partners in industry and academia, and acquired more than a dozen projects with a six-figure total volume.

positions.title: Visiting Scholar
positions.description: In collaboration with Prof. Yale Braunstein and other researchers at the School of Information, I wrote my master’s thesis on "Value Creation Patterns in Service Ecosystems". Also I completed two courses at the Haas School of Business.

positions.title: Werkstudent
positions.description: As part-time consultant in Advisory: Performance and Technology, I worked on a global shared service center project for a leading engineering company, designed and implemented a database for a property management firm, and helped implement an internal HR platform at KPMG. I mainly worked with Microsoft SharePoint, Access, Excel and PowerPoint, including VBA to access web services and automatically create real-time reports.

positions.title: Wissenschaftliche Hilfskraft
positions.description: As student research assistant at the chair for Information Systems (Prof. Krcmar) I worked on the BMWi project THESEUS aimed at creating the foundations for the Internet of Services. My main activities were ontology modelling, documentation of results, quality management, and general desk research.

company.name: Alasco
company.description:
Alasco is the financial management platform for real estate companies managing development, retrofit, and tenant improvement projects. Alasco helps real estate companies shift from reactive cost control to strategic financial management and set in place the financial data layer for a solid AI strategy.

With rapid time-to-value, the Alasco platform unites all stakeholders around a single source of truth, helping them plan, budget, analyse, optimise and execute on their business plans.

The platform is used by over 350 real estate players across Europe who collectively manage on Alasco more than €1Tn in project development volume to date. Key customers include: Hines, JLL, LaSalle, Ardian, ECE Gruppe, Alcaro Invest and Patrizia SE.
